mechanism: Phenelzine (MAOI) combined with deutetrabenazine (dopamine depleter with monoamine reuptake inhibition properties) creates risk of hypertensive crisis, serotonin syndrome, and CNS effects through monoamine accumulation.
action: Avoid this combination; if clinically necessary, require at least 14-day washout of phenelzine before deutetrabenazine initiation and close monitoring for hypertensive crisis and adverse CNS effects.
